test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What, according to the passage, is a possible way to manage the large carbon foot-print caused by the fast-food industry?

options.text: By going back to traditional techniques of cooking and regional food cultures.
By not participating in fast-food businesses at all.
By consuming only home cooked food.
By associating with Slow Food International.

solution:
The correct answer is "**By going back to traditional techniques of cooking and regional food cultures.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the passage, a possible way to manage the large carbon footprint caused by the fast-food industry is by **going back to traditional techniques of cooking and regional food cultures**.
 
• This is being promoted by **Indian members of Relais & Chateaux in partnership with Slow Food International**.
 
• Let's have a look at the** third, fourth and fifth lines** of the passage:
 
 
• *So heady, that we often forget that food has a large carbon footprint, and the menace of ever-growing fast-food businesses that contribute the lion's share to this problem. **However, India's rich traditional and local edible biodiversity, with its focus on home cooked food, presents a ray of hope. **Indian members of Relais & Chateaux, in partnership with Slow Food International, hope to bring back our forefathers' wisdom when it comes to eating, through the Slow Food Movement, which started in the 1980s and aims to bring to the fore the connection of plate with people and the planet.*
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.
